# App

Root component of the application: provides the context for messages (useMessage) and danger confirmations
(useConfirmDanger), so that they use the current theme. Place it inside ThemeProvider at the outermost level and
wrap the application only once; a nested App uses the messages of the outer one, so there are never two stacks.
Messages are rendered at the bottom center of `document.body`, at most 3 at a time; they disappear after 4
seconds by default, and the timer pauses while the pointer is over them.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Root component of the application; wrap standalone pages or tests that need messages or confirmations

## Import

```ts
import { App } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Place it inside ThemeProvider at the root of the application; only components inside it can use useMessage
and useConfirmDanger. Messages appear at the bottom center of the screen.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <App>
      <SaveButton />
    </App>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `MessageConfig` | Global settings of messages. Only applies to the outermost App: nested Apps use the messages of the outer one. | — | No |

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`AppProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
